title: Finding Record
description: finding-record/v1 (stack ADR-078 spec S5.2). The shared, append-only record every Sweep check emits and every downstream consumer (renderer, roster-keeper, agent audit) reads. No finding-record field may ever contain a database cell value, credential, or personal identifier (G8) - enforced by sweep-emit.sh, not by this schema alone.

schema.description: Schema identifier and version tag for this record. Always the literal string finding-record/v1.

finding_id.description: finding_id = sha256(repo + check_id + mechanism + normalized_locus + identity_key)[:16]. Deterministic so the same underlying defect re-emits the same id across runs (dedup key). what is NEVER hashed.

identity_key.description: The stable name of the thing this finding is about (e.g. a field, a route, a check id). Must NOT match a UUID, an ISO-8601 timestamp, or a 4+ digit run number - those are run identity, not finding identity.

run_id.description: Composite identifier for the Sweep run that produced this record (UTC start timestamp + short commit sha or equivalent).

repo.description: The repository this finding was produced against.

created_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of when this finding record was emitted.

what.description: Technical, mechanistic description of the defect - the evidence a reviewer needs to confirm the finding is real.

plain.description: Exactly one plain-English sentence describing user-visible impact. No check ids, no family letters (sweep-family-A etc.), no .ts/file paths (spec S4.6 G2 wording).

mechanism.description: The category of failure mechanism this finding represents.

surface.description: The system surface affected. null when surface_source is unset (e.g. a human-walkthrough finding that has not been classified yet).

surface_source.description: Whether surface was declared by the emitting check (declared) or left unclassified (unset).

found_by.description: The mechanism or check family that surfaced this finding.

evidence.description: The verifiable basis for this finding. At least one of commit or locus is required.

commit.description: The commit sha this finding's evidence was gathered against.

locus.description: The file:line or equivalent location the evidence points to.

measurement.description: The quantified basis for this finding - what was counted, out of what, and how.

statement.description: One-line description of what was counted.

denominator.description: The total population count was measured against.

source.description: Where the measurement was gathered from.

liveness.description: Structural liveness invariant for the check that emitted this finding (spec S4.2). Proves the check actually ran and asserted something.

assertions_executed.description: Total number of assertions the emitting check executed this run.

assertions_passed.description: Number of those assertions that passed.

responsible_agent.description: The agent role identified as responsible for this class of defect, or null if not yet attributed. NEVER prompted from the user directly (roster-keeper's surface, decision 7).

roster_action.description: The roster-keeper action this finding implies, or null if not yet triaged.

status.description: Disposition of this finding. NOT present on check-emitted rows (spec S4.3) - only on disposition rows written after triage.
